source.shows: a heatmap of many series over time (R6-36): a row per state (50 states and DC, by postal code), a column per year, the years on round multiples under the grid, the cells in steps of a sequential ramp, darker meaning more: the values are skewed (one of seven equal steps would hold 80 % of them), the pattern among the many is the message (facts.ramp_focus pattern), and the rates span four orders of magnitude (the 95th percentile of the positive values about 10,600 times the 5th), so logarithmic 1–2–5 steps, zero its own (0 | under 1 | 1–10 | 10–100 | 100–1,000 | 1,000 or more: G4.33, automatic over two orders of magnitude, owner, 1 Oct 2026), which show the fall after 1963 step by step, the key a bar of the classes with the breaks under it, above the grid at its right, the values not known grey with their own key entry; the data are synthetic after the shape of the book's figure (Project Tycho, not in the notes): a level per state, epidemics every two or three years, a fall after 1963 by a factor e every 2.2 years, a few years not known (AK and HI before 1950); the book's vaccine line is not drawn; variants natural (natural breaks rounded, G4.30, asked for with its reason: 0 | 120 | 370 | 690 | 1,200 | 2,000 or more, the post-vaccine years and the low pre-vaccine ones in one step), extremes (facts.ramp_focus extremes: equal steps on rounded values, G4.29) and quantile (equal counts, G4.31, with its reason, the key saying so)
